evidence.source_location: Section 2 and Equation (2); inverse-probability scaling proposal
evidence.distinction: Equation (2) gives d/dt log(p_i/p_j)=p_i(r_i-R)-p_j(r_j-R). The source studies objective-induced outcome collapse, but universal-collapse wording is too broad: for constant rewards all advantages and gradients vanish. The revised manuscript cites the study and proposed correction, not such a blanket guarantee.
